Rho 0.4.0 brings the three-platform scientific workbench to the stable channel.

## Platforms

- Windows x64 installer with two-stage Authenticode signing and installed-byte
  verification.
- macOS Apple Silicon disk image signed with Developer ID, notarized, and
  stapled by Apple.
- Linux x86-64 AppImage with the final AppRun wrapper and signed updater bytes.

## Automatic updates

- Stable and development installations use signed Windows, macOS, and Linux
  updater artifacts.
- Update checks begin after the local workbench is ready. Verification or
  installation failure preserves the currently running version.

## Windows trust

- Windows packages use the SignPath Free Trial self-signed test certificate.
  It is not publicly trusted, and Windows or SmartScreen may still warn.
